title: 13 NEW Cessna 172 Liveries + Alpine H125 Packs! | MSFS 2024 Marketplace
description:
Are you looking to expand your visual customization in Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 this week, or are you deciding which new Marketplace add-ons are worth your investment? Today, we are breaking down a focused slate of visual releases—bringing authentic factory paint schemes to the default Skyhawk and dedicated Alpine utility liveries to the rotary wing fleet!

In this marketplace breakdown, we take a close look at liveries, variant support, real-world paint schemes, and new visual releases across the MSFS 2024 virtual flight line:

✈️ CESSNA 172 AUTHENTIC LIVERY PACK (BURNING BLUE DESIGN)
We kick things off with Burning Blue Design's Cessna 172 Authentic Livery Pack, delivering 13 high-quality exterior paint schemes based on real-world Skyhawk aircraft. We look at the period-accurate factory styling, distinctive Skyhawk II and Airstream aesthetics, and full compatibility across every MSFS 2024 variant—including passenger, skis, amphibian floats, taildragger, skydive, and cargo configurations on both G1000 and steam gauge panels. Plus, an overview of the Marketplace rental option so you can test them before purchasing.

🚁 AIRBUS H125 AUSTRIAN LIVERY PACKS 3 & 4 (HR SIMYARD)
Heading into the Alps? We inspect HR Simyard’s latest expansions for the Airbus H125 utility helicopter. Pack 3 delivers real-world Austrian schemes including Heli Austria classic red-and-white, Bumblebee, metallic green, lime green, and sky blue. We also examine Pack 4, introducing operational liveries from Wucher Helicopter (Falco) and Kitz-air's fleet designs—ideal for heavy mountain work, cargo sling operations, and scenic Alpine charter flights.

Which of these paint schemes are you loading onto the flight line first? Taking the classic Skyhawk II on a cross-country flight, or flying Alpine sling operations in the H125? Let us know in the comments below!

If you find these marketplace breakdowns helpful, don't forget to hit the like button, subscribe for weekly flight sim coverage, and clear skies on your next flight!
